case: SQLite numeric-affinity grid edits and CSV imports preserve text and exact numeric values without affinity rounding
contract: SQLite INTEGER, REAL and NUMERIC grid edits retain clearly nonnumeric input as TEXT; MySQL and SQL Server remain strict.
Exactly representable decimal inputs such as 42.50 remain accepted for SQLite numeric affinity columns; numeric-looking overflow and excess precision are rejected before affinity can round them.
Native SQLite typeof() confirms edited/imported storage classes and untouched sibling rows retain their original native values.
A live keyed grid edit of 42.50 in an INTEGER-affinity column stores REAL 42.5; storage class, exact value and sibling row assertions guard the conversion.

focused_test.command: rtk proxy cargo test --manifest-path Cargo.toml -p tablepro-app --all-features --lib ui::browse_tab::value_parse::tests::sqlite_numeric_affinity::sqlite_numeric_affinity_grid_edit_preserves_text_and_sibling_values -- --exact --test-threads=1
